priorities.summary: Command injection in DrayTek Vigor2960 1.5.1.6 (set_table in /cgi-bin/mainfunction.cgi) via a manipulated sectiontype argument; remotely exploitable with a public exploit. The device is end-of-support — replace it, as only major unauthenticated issues get reviewed.

Buffer overflow in Tenda BE3L Pro 16.03.60.62 (formWifiBasicSet in /goform/WifiBasicSet) via a manipulated security_5g argument; remotely exploitable with a published exploit. Patch or retire affected units.

PHP object injection in the WordPress Prime Mover backup/migration plugin up to 2.2.1 via deserialization in the migration search-and-replace routine; an unauthenticated attacker can plant a crafted serialized object through a comment. Update past 2.2.1 immediately.

model.name: Kimi K3.1 Pro
model.summary: Moonshot AI's Oct 23 release is a heavily post-trained Kimi K3 (2.8T parameters, 1M context) that scores 55 on Artificial Analysis' Intelligence Index — fourth overall and within 3 points of the frontier. Full open weights are promised by Nov 4, which would make it the highest-scoring open-weight model ever.
